lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Reform office. Nine of us, four years, and one amendment tabled between the lot of us, which was not mine.

lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Vesely's, that was. She got a clause into the Handover and then she vanished, and nobody in this building will say the word.

lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: You are Vesely. You are supposed to be a cautionary tale and you are standing in the kitchen.
